pins.name: BUILTIN_BUTTON
pins.label: GPIO0 (Button)
pins.notes:
Must be HIGH or floating for normal boot; LOW at boot enters flash/programming mode. No interrupt support. This board's onboard user/pairing pushbutton (BUTTON_BUILTIN) — see pfodWeb NOTE above pinNotes for sources
BUTTON_BUILTIN — onboard user/pairing pushbutton (schematic/vendor-doc confirmed, see pfodWeb NOTE above)

pins.name: GPIO1
pins.label: GPIO1
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 TX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO

pins.name: GPIO2
pins.label: GPIO2
pins.notes: Must be HIGH at boot. Commonly wired to the on-board LED on dev boards

pins.name: GPIO3
pins.label: GPIO3
pins.notes: Hardware UART0 RX0 — used by the Serial pfod connection, not available as a general GPIO

pins.name: BUILTIN_RELAY
pins.label: BUILTIN_RELAY (GPIO12)
pins.notes:
This board's relay output (RELAY_BUILTIN) driving the mains switch — active-high, kept as a plain digital output, not a button/LED capability — see pfodWeb NOTE above pinNotes for sources
RELAY_BUILTIN — onboard mains relay output, kept available (not tagged button/LED) — see pfodWeb NOTE above

pins.name: GPIO13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active low)
pins.notes:
This board's onboard status LED (LED_BUILTIN) — active-low — see pfodWeb NOTE above pinNotes for sources
LED_BUILTIN — onboard status LED, active-low (schematic/vendor-doc confirmed, see pfodWeb NOTE above)

pins.name: SS
pins.label: SS (GPIO15)
pins.notes: Must be LOW at boot (tied to GND via resistor on most boards)

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes: RTC-domain pin: no internal pull-up/down, no PWM, no interrupt support. Commonly wired to RST for deep-sleep wake

pins.name: A0
pins.label: A0 (GPIO17)
pins.notes: Analog input only (A0) — not broken out on this board (no analog-sensing header on a mains relay switch); native range would be 0-1.0V on the bare chip if wired externally — see adc note below
